summary.intent: Execute trail 167 (architecture drift findings ARCH-3, 4, 5, 6 from the 2026-11-02 review): move PipelineOptions out of the pipeline module to break resolver/loader dependency on pipeline, and refresh ARCHITECTURE.md, type-checker docs and ADR statuses to match the code.
summary.outcome: Two signed, committed branches off main (refactor/options-out-of-pipeline and docs/refresh-architecture-and-adr-status) that merge cleanly together. The refactor passes 1067 tests, 13/13 architecture tests, lint and semver checks; the docs branch passes lint/doc-check/typos. Nothing is pushed or opened as a PR.

repo: Architecture is enforced by crates/core/tests/architecture.rs, which checks module import direction and uses an allowlist with a reason for each remaining edge; the rule now also catches grouped `use crate::{...}` imports, with a negative test.
The `pipeline` module re-exports PipelineOptions, HtmlAttributeMode and CollapseInheritedProps, so public paths stay stable after the move to types/options.rs.
Verification commands: `just lint doc-check typos machete`, `just semver` (196 checks), and workspace nextest (1067 passed, 1 skipped).
ADRs are not rewritten; per docs/adr/README.md they get dated status notes, and the README index lines must be kept in sync.
Core does file I/O (discovery, module resolution, caches, tsconfig) but never spawns a process; docs had wrongly said 'pure extraction, no I/O'.
No changeset is needed for pure moves or docs-only changes.
Docs referenced nonexistent symbols (WatchRevision, ScopedKey, resolve_complex_types); each claim was verified by grep against crates/ before editing.
The NAPI binding has 15 #[napi] functions and 15 contain_panic call sites; ExtractionOutput SCHEMA_VERSION is 4.

code.finding: The watch revision is held as ArcSwapOption<Revision>; the docs' 'WatchRevision' type does not exist.
PropType streams on serialize; it uses serde_json::Value only on deserialize (line 896).
CollectedType goes through serde_json::Value both ways via to_json_value.
The only recursion_limit (256) in the workspace; core's lib.rs sets none.

workflow: Delegated work ran in a git worktree with separate signed commits per concern, and `git merge-tree` confirmed the branches merge without conflict.
Each doc claim was proved by grep or counting before editing, and the proofs were summarized in the PR body.
Draft PR bodies were prepared but nothing was pushed or opened, leaving that outward-facing step for the user.

friction: Fully breaking the architecture edges was not possible with pure moves: types/options.rs still needs crate::plugin, and resolver/mod.rs still needs dependency_types::DependencyLayer.
Documentation overlaps with trail 164's unmerged PR #300, which risks conflicts on lines 3 and 7 of docs/type-checker-integration.md.
open_items: Break the types/options.rs -> crate::plugin edge by moving PluginRegistry and DocgenPlugin under types/ or making the registry generic.
Break the resolver -> dependency_types::DependencyLayer edge by moving DependencyLayer and its helpers under types/.
If PR #300 (trail 164) merges first, add notes to ADR 0006 and 0007 about the session notifying the checker on dependency edits, and resolve possible conflicts in docs/type-checker-integration.md.
Push both branches and open the PRs (not yet done).
